name: web-dark-location-card-with-grid-map-live-badge-and-mint-pin
title: Frosted dark map card with a line grid, translucent blocks, a mint pin, a LIVE badge and San Francisco coordinates in monospace
whatItIs: A black page with a small caps label 'CURRENT LOCATION' above a translucent rounded card that shows an abstract street grid with frosted rectangles as buildings, a glowing mint location pin at the centre, a 'LIVE' pill with a green dot at the top right and at the bottom 'San Francisco, CA' with monospace coordinates and a thin mint progress line.
whatItMeans: Precise and modern; an abstract grid map with one mint pin is enough to say 'you are here'.
techniques: Abstract a map into grid lines and frosted blocks.

vocabulary.definition: A simplified grid standing in for a map.
A pill with a green dot showing real-time status.
A translucent rectangle used as a building.
